title: Curating Cuttlefish
statement: Basking in dappled teal light among sunken slate arches and swaying ribbons of sea-lettuce, this wide-eyed miniature cephalopod spends its days sorting sea-glass and tiny shells into neat color gradients. Whenever it completes a particularly pleasing arrangement, its skin ripples with soft bioluminescent waves like a quiet round of applause.
